data.name: Hadee
data.gender_notes: Hadee is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hadee means 'guide', 'helper' or 'companion'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'h-d-y', which connotes the concept of guidance and assistance. The name Hadee carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hadee usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the spirit of helping and guiding others.
data.etymology: Hadee belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadee total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) is described as a Hadee (Guide) for the Nation (Ummah) in the Quran, and Muslims are constantly encouraged to follow His teachings as a means of guidance towards the right path. Moreover, Islamic scholars and teachers are often referred to as Hadees because they help people understand Islamic teachings and practices, thus guiding them on the right path in their religious and moral lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hadee also holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it embodies the concept of divine guidance and assistance. Muslims believe that Allah, the Almighty God, always guides and helps them in their lives. The Quran states, "And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good news and a warner, and there does not come to them, after its coming to them, a messenger or a warner from their Lord.
